mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS friend_id, u.username AS name, u.avatar, u.game_rank AS game_rank FROM friend f JOIN user u ON u.user_id = f.friend_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1 UNION SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS friend_id, u.username AS name, u.avatar, u.game_rank AS game_rank FROM friend f JOIN user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.friend_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1

SELECT x.friend_id AS session_id, 'private' AS session_type, u.username AS name, u.avatar AS avatar, ( SELECT pm.content FROM private_message pm WHERE (pm.from_id = #{userId} AND pm.to_id = x.friend_id) OR (pm.from_id = x.friend_id AND pm.to_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY pm.send_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_msg, ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pm.send_time, '%m-%d %H:%i') FROM private_message pm WHERE (pm.from_id = #{userId} AND pm.to_id = x.friend_id) OR (pm.from_id = x.friend_id AND pm.to_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY pm.send_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_time FROM ( SELECT f.friend_id FROM friend f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1 UNION SELECT f.user_id AS friend_id FROM friend f WHERE f.friend_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1 ) x JOIN user u ON u.user_id = x.friend_id
